# AVI-SPLEarnsCiscoPoweredMeetingRoomsSpecialization

![](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/593e2e5fb2c5884dd0d5bc2d66d0ec0137df2f09f3d950a2bffb688a7337745e?s=44&d=mm&r=g)

[Share on Twitter](http://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=AVI-SPL+Earns+Cisco+Powered+Meeting+Rooms+Specialization%20https%3A%2F%2Favispl.com%2Fblog%2Favi-spl-cisco-powered-meeting-rooms-specialization%2F)

![AVI-SPL has earned the Cisco Powered Meeting Rooms Specialization, recognizing our ability to design Cisco meeting room environments at scale](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-09-21-122011.png)

AVI-SPL has achieved the **Cisco Powered Meeting Rooms Specialization**, a designation recognizing our ability to design, deploy and manage Cisco meeting room environments at scale.

The specialization demonstrates AVI-SPL’s capabilities across the full meeting room service lifecycle, from solution design and deployment to ongoing monitoring, support and lifecycle management. It provides customers with confidence that their meeting room environments can be supported by a partner whose processes and capabilities have been independently validated by Cisco.

#### **Validating the Full Meeting Room Experience**

Earning the specialization required AVI-SPL to complete a comprehensive Cisco audit covering key areas of meeting room delivery and managed services. The successful evaluation included pre-sales and solution design, onboarding and activation, monitoring and lifecycle management, incident and service request management, interoperability across platforms, room scheduling integration and documented service management practices.

Achieving this new specialization demonstrates AVI-SPL’s capability in technology integration, managed services and operational excellence to support our customers’ collaboration needs in the modern workplace today and future proofing their investments throughout their journey.

#### Supporting More Reliable Meeting Room Operations

Maintaining consistent performance can be complex. Technology needs to be monitored, updated and supported while minimizing disruption for the people relying on those spaces every day.

The specialization reinforces our ability to help address those challenges through proactive monitoring, defined service processes, lifecycle management and ongoing support.

The result is a more streamlined approach to meeting room operations that can help organizations reduce complexity, maintain a consistent user experience and get more value from their technology investments.

#### **A Cisco-Validated Approach to Managed Services**

The new designation adds value for AVI-SPL as a Cisco partner and further validates our Cisco expertise for our customers.

AVI-SPL is now recognized as Cisco Powered Meeting Rooms-specialized on Cisco’s Partner Locator, giving organizations a public resource for verifying the designation.

More broadly, the specialization reflects AVI-SPL’s approach to managed services. It combines technology expertise with the processes, monitoring and support required to keep workplace environments operating effectively over time. Finally, aligns AVI-SPL Digital Workplace Experience strategy in the shift from workspace to the workplace and from service delivery to service management.
